4. Deepen your SEO Knowledge Broken link building

Want to earn high-quality backlinks by helping other websites fix broken ones? This lesson on broken link building teaches you how to use one of SEO’s most effective and value-driven link acquisition strategies to grow your authority and rankings.

Broken link building combines technical auditing with strategic outreach—identifying dead links on relevant sites and offering your content as a replacement. It’s a win-win: site owners get a better user experience, and you earn authoritative backlinks that improve your SEO performance.

These expert-curated resources walk you through every step of the process, from finding broken link opportunities and using the right tools to crafting outreach emails that get results. Explore the guides below to master broken backlink strategies and scale your link building efforts with proven, ethical tactics.

Frequently Asked Questions on Broken Link Building

Broken link building is an advanced link building strategy where you find broken external links on relevant websites, create content that matches what the broken link originally pointed to, then reach out to the site owner suggesting they replace the broken link with a link to your content.

Use tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, Sistrix, SE Ranking to identify broken links on relevant sites in your niche. Focus on resource pages, industry roundups, and educational content where broken links are most common and replacements are welcomed.

Start by genuinely helping the site owner—point out the broken link and explain how it affects user experience. Then suggest your relevant content as a replacement. Keep emails personalized, concise, and focused on the value you’re providing to their readers.

Yes, broken link building remains highly effective because it provides mutual value. Website owners appreciate fixing broken links that hurt user experience, and you earn quality backlinks from relevant sites. Success rates are typically higher than cold outreach since you’re solving a real problem.

Essential tools include those like Ahrefs, Semrush, Sistrix, SE Ranking for finding broken link opportunities, Hunter.io or Voila Norbert for finding contact information, Check My Links for quick broken link detection, and email outreach tools like Pitchbox or BuzzStream for managing campaigns at scale.
